subject: Bridge letter request to cover post-report period for Solarex
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@solarex.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: security@solarex.io
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II and bridge-letter request (coverage from 2025-12-31 to today)

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking my earlier call. We are in the final stages of our vendor assessment for a new data platform program and have a couple of documentation asks before we can progress:

- A copy of Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report (reporting period ending 2025-12-31).
- A signed bridge letter or alternate attestation that covers the period from the report end date (2025-12-31) through to the current date (we need confirmation of no material control changes or a description of any gaps and mitigations).
- Confirmation on three controls in scope for our review: logging/alerting retention, backup & recovery procedures, and access review cadence.

Can you confirm whether you can provide a bridge letter and an estimated turnaround to get a signed copy? If you prefer, we can accept a draft letter and then a DocuSign-signed version.

Also attaching a short SIG-lite and a vendor risk intake form for context. If you need a single point of contact on our side, that's me.

Best,
Elena
--
Elena Rossi
Head of Vendor Risk
Solarex Inc.
elena.rossi@solarex.io
[Attachment: Solarex_SIG_L1.xlsx (XLSX, 120 KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@solarex.io>
Cc: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and bridge-letter request (coverage from 2025-12-31 to today)

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and the SIG.

We can provide the SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2025-12-31 and a bridge letter that addresses the post-report period up to the date of signature. Preliminary answers to your three control questions below:

- Logging/Alerting retention: We retain system logs and alert data for 13 months; aggregated SIEM logs are stored for 24 months.
- Backup & recovery: Nightly backups with quarterly restore drills; RTO targets documented in our DR runbook.
- Access review cadence: Quarterly role-based access reviews; emergency access lifted within 48 hours with retrospective approval.

Next steps: I will attach the SOC2 PDF and a draft bridge letter for your review. Priya — can you confirm legal is comfortable with the standard bridge wording and if we can route the final to e-sign? Rishi — please confirm internal signatory (I propose CTO or Head of Security).

Target: send draft to Solarex by EOD tomorrow (Fri 2026-09-11) and get final signed within 7 business days if acceptable.

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_2025_Report.pdf, draft_bridge_letter-solarex.docx

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
[Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_2025_Report.pdf (PDF, 4.8 MB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II and bridge-letter request (Solarex) — need legal signoff

Priya / Rishi,

Forwarding Solarex's request. Draft bridge letter is attached ("draft_bridge_letter-solarex.docx"). Key asks from Solarex: confirmation that controls are consistent since 2025-12-31 and an executed bridge letter.

Can Legal review the attached draft for any language we should soften (material change, remediation windows, indemnity concerns)? If legal signs off, Rishi can we use CTO signature block and route via DocuSign (link below)?

Proposed timeline:
- Legal review by EOD Mon 2026-09-14
- Exec sign + DocuSign send by Tue 2026-09-15

DocuSign prep link: https://docusign.com/req/ABC-123-solarex-bridge

Thanks — this is straightforward but they are on a tight procurement timeline.

Mina
[Attachment: draft_bridge_letter-solarex.docx (DOCX, 42 KB)]

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@solarex.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 15:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II and bridge-letter request (coverage from 2025-12-31 to today)

Thanks Mina — appreciate the quick turnaround. We received the draft and SOC2 report; attaching our completed intake and a short security questionnaire for your records. Two quick clarifications:

1) Will Redwood confirm the bridge letter will state explicitly that there have been no material changes to controls relevant to data processing, encryption at rest, and multi-factor auth since 2025-12-31?
2) Can you provide an expected signature ETA once Legal signs off? We plan to finalize vendor onboarding the week of 2026-09-20 and would need the signed bridge letter before the vendor review board meets.

If you can route via DocuSign that works best for our compliance team — please use the link above or send the signed PDF.

Best regards,
Elena

[Attachment: Solarex_Vendor_Intake.pdf (PDF, 220 KB), Solarex_Security_Questions.pdf (PDF, 65 KB)]
